prompt: A Python queue worker can receive a payment message twice, including concurrently. It checks a stored key, calls a remote payment service, and then records completion. A process can crash between those steps. Propose the smallest safe design and verification without assuming a cloud or exactly-once transport.

criteria.description: Identifies both the concurrent check/effect race and crash-after-effect window; a local key/claim alone is not proof of remote effect atomicity.
Requires actual provider-enforced idempotency, transaction scope or reconciliation evidence and states unresolved duplicate/unknown-outcome risk.
Bounds active work, backlog and retry/redrive behavior using actual transport guarantees without prescribing a mandatory DLQ or unbounded Promise.all.
